name: Omanoise
author: Joshua Doms
description: Procedural focus soundscapes in the bar, in the spirit of Endel. Sampled piano, harp and vibraphone (libfluidsynth) are sequenced over PADsynth pads and a quiet noise bed in Focus and Relax modes, plus an Environment mode that blends ocean, rain, fireplace, wind, stream and birdsong on their own sliders. Nothing loops: recordings play as randomly scheduled crossfaded segments. Adapts to the time of day and is tuned for calm — slow attacks, major pentatonic, no periodic modulation.

barWidget.description: Generative concentration soundscapes: play/pause, mode, a blendable ocean/rain/fire/wind/stream/birds environment, intensity, brightness, tonal balance, 16 Hz neural modulation, binaural beats and a stop-after timer.

schema.label: Start playing when the shell starts
schema.description: Resume the soundscape automatically after login or a shell restart.
